summary: Independent exact-HEAD E2E/harness review confirmed component markers for Compose provenance/health, commercial seed and activation, baseline accounting, PostgreSQL outage fail-closed behavior, 600-second drain, production recovery fencing, Redis stop/epoch/hash/limit fail-closed cases, restoration, and final accounting. The original exact log ends after the post-restore marker without a same-process aggregate marker; the aggregate was independently asserted but its replay provenance is not retained in the 03b record. The Redis driver prints upstream_attempts=0 as a literal and does not query mock counters, so no-upstream claims for Redis failures are unsupported by that harness. A fresh exact-HEAD HTTP proof now covers model discovery, JSON/SSE/compact, rejection, and pre-byte failover, but no exact-HEAD real gateway simultaneous cap-4 or image-route E2E was retained; unit/miniredis coverage is strong. Phase 2 remains needs-verification pending production-shaped performance evidence and simultaneous-cap proof.
